title: The “luxury bag” TikTok
note: In late December 2022 a teenager’s TikTok about being mocked for calling her Charles & Keith bag a luxury item went viral, and the brand responded publicly. The Wikipedia spike didn’t come until mid-January, when the story reached the international press. Takeaway: the video started it, but the press coverage is what turned it into mass curiosity.

title: The John Boyega ambassador row
note: John Boyega stepped down as a Jo Malone London ambassador after the brand recut his campaign for China with a local actor in his place. The data shows two peaks a few days apart: the news itself, then the follow-up coverage.
